links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of five multimodal LLMs compared on the same pediatric chest X-ray dataset
links.effect: GPT-4.1 had 84% sensitivity and 76% specificity; GPT-4o 99%/18%; Gemini 2.5 Pro 97%/25%; Claude 4 Sonnet 100%/0%; Grok 2 Vision 82%/56%.
links.quote: GPT-4.1 demonstrated the most balanced performance with 84% sensitivity and 76% specificity.

links.outcome: Binary pneumonia classification performance of general-purpose multimodal LLMs on pediatric chest X-rays
links.effect: Most models showed high sensitivity but poor specificity (GPT-4o 18%, Gemini 25%, Claude 0%), indicating a strong false-positive tendency.
links.quote: Claude 4 Sonnet classified all images as pneumonia (100% sensitivity, 0% specificity).

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic classification performance of several multimodal LLMs on a retrospective pediatric chest X-ray benchmark dataset without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
